name: bld2_tripotent_rank_split
statement: (K : Type*) [Field K] [CharZero K] (ι : Type*) [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (A : Matrix ι ι K) (h : A * A * A = A) : Matrix.rank A = Matrix.rank (A * A + A) + Matrix.rank (A * A - A)
closed: ∀ (K : Type*) [Field K] [CharZero K] (ι : Type*) [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (A : Matrix ι ι K) (h : A * A * A = A), Matrix.rank A = Matrix.rank (A * A + A) + Matrix.rank (A * A - A)
informal: Uses Mathlib2.bld_idempotent_sum_rank: P = (1/2)(A*A + A) and Q = (1/2)(A*A - A) are idempotents whose sum A*A is idempotent, so rank (A*A) = rank P + rank Q; scalars 1/2 do not change rank and rank (A*A) = rank A since A = A*(A*A).
type: ∀ (K : Type u_1) [inst : Field K] [CharZero K] (ι : Type u_2) [inst_2 : Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (A : Matrix ι ι K), A * A * A = A → A.rank = (A * A + A).rank + (A * A - A).rank
